# cpanel_mysql_user (Data Source)

Looks up a cPanel MySQL or MariaDB user by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_user" "user" {
  name = "sc1john1234_user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The database user name, including the cPanel database prefix.
